raw:
The door opens on a young woman in white and gold, one hand still lifted from the knock. Warm light seems to rest against her skin rather than fall on it. Small white wings fold neatly behind her shoulders.

Her blue eyes take in the signet at your hand, then return to your face.

“Seraphel Dawnquill,” she says. “First year, like you.  
The dining hall is downstairs.  
Would you like company on the way?”
